definition: Your leader card. Sits in the Oshi position, has LIFE instead of HP, and unlocks powerful Oshi Skills fueled by holo Power.
Talent cards representing hololive members. They perform Arts, take damage, and stack when damaged (downed states).
Special holomem with their own buzz rules — typically limited copies per deck and unique entry conditions.
A holomem's growth stage: Debut → 1st → 2nd. Cards bloom by stacking onto each other, gaining stats and stronger effects. Spot is a special bloom position for some cards.
Retiring an active holomem to pass benefits to the next one — the game's core momentum mechanic.
A holomem's attack ability, usually costing holo Power and sometimes colored icons (e.g. white/red) to use.
The resource you generate each turn (often from downed/stacked cards) used to pay for Arts, Oshi Skills and other costs.
A repeatable leader ability paid with holo Power — usually usable once per turn ([1/Turn]).
A once-per-game super version of an Oshi Skill with dramatic effects.
Your team's hit counter, shown on your Oshi card. Losing all Life loses the game. Some Oshi skills convert damage into Life changes.
Bonus effects some cards gain when a matching condition or color combination is met during a Collab state.
The discard pile zone. Several effects retrieve or manipulate Archive cards.
Support card type themed on fan cheering; often provides resource or draw effects.
Cards marked LIMITED have deck-building restrictions (typically 1-copy) noted in their Extra text.
Deck-building mode where all cards must share a single color; many sets reward staying unicolor.
